notes: Final Google Calendar sync fix + manual task-connection management (1.11.9): NO fuzzy auto-linking — the slot-match and title-similarity tiers added in 1.11.7 are removed; a pull links only by stored Event ID (UID, survives any title/time/date change) or by an exact (date+start+title) triple for first-time linking of boxes with no Event ID yet, and an ambiguous exact match links nothing. Disconnected (orphaned) boxes STAY in the dashboard/programme — the 1.11.7 hiding in isCurrentBox() is reverted; only the «متصل» badge disappears. Every task card/row (daily programme, assignments, backlog, review-past, archive) shows a calendar icon + «متصل» badge when really connected (stored Event ID) and a three-dot menu: delete (with confirm, tombstones the UID), move to backlog (state.backlogPinned flag, view-only, reversible), keep in programme, reconnect to calendar (GET /api/calendar/unlinked picker + POST /api/boxes/reconnect; duplicate absorbed only when it holds no user data, else 409; idempotent; pre-migration backup taken and verified). New topbar «همگام‌سازی تقویم» button next to the auto-save pill: same POST /api/calendar/sync as the Backup tab's manual button, disabled while syncing, short result (last-sync time + added/updated/unlinked) next to it, short readable error on failure. Book sections have no Event ID, so no badge/menu there. No change to sync/merge/push logic otherwise, Google-wins, tombstones, ICS fetch, OAuth/push paths, two-way done sync, idempotent sync, or the programme range (2026-10-24…2026-12-18).
